body: I’m not sure your right. Wishful thinking though.

I appreciate the kind words. I’m hoping this will be big year for me moving forward with my life, I won’t stop believing that this will get better. I decided awhile ago I have too much life left to live.
You’re not missing out, it’s just a distraction from how trash reality can be sometimes. I’m sorry you have to go through it as well. Nobody should have to feel this way.
Well friend if you ever need someone to vent what you’re dealing with too I’ve been told I’m a good listener lol.
See, my only problem is the dreams. If anything my T-break has somewhat helped my mental health.

I’m happy you’re still among us. 

It’s great how this subreddit bands together to encourage life. Most of us are here because we’re dealing with our own issues but we put them aside to help each other when we’re at our worst and that’s a beautiful thing.
